Subject: Indigo pilot — signature milestones and legal gating

Tessa — thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. The leadership team liked the demo; before we lock dates we need a short mutual action plan that shows which legal/ procurement gates are sequential vs parallel. Two asks from our side: (1) can you map the MSA/DPA/order form approval path with expected lead times, and (2) confirm what security artifacts (SOC 2, data processing addendum) you can provide this week so our InfoSec can start their review in parallel.

High-level constraints from procurement: we officially start purchase once legal signs the DPA and Order Form (PO issuance typically takes ~3 weeks post legal sign-off). We can try to sign the MSA earlier, but DPA is the gating doc for data processing.

Anil
Director, Partnerships — Indigo Health

Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Indigo pilot — signature milestones and legal gating

Thanks Anil — attaching a first-pass MAP that separates parallel tasks from hard dependencies (see tab "Sequencing"). Key assumptions up-front:
- MSA (standard Redwood customer MSA) can be negotiated in parallel with the evaluation but is not required to start pilot infra provisioning.
- DPA: must be executed before production data is processed; we can provision a locked test environment before DPA signature for evaluation purposes.
- Order Form: ties to billing and activation; procurement requires signed DPA + Order Form to issue a PO.

Proposed high-level timeline (subject to your legal review):
1) Week 0 (today): Share MAP + SOC 2 Type II artifacts and DPA redline template.
2) Week 1–2: Indigo InfoSec review SOC 2 + security questionnaire (can run in parallel with MSA negotiations).
3) Week 2–3: DPA review & sign.
4) Week 3–4: Order Form finalization and signature.
5) Week 6: PO issued by procurement and provisioning of Dedicated pool begins.

I've attached: Indigo_MAP_v1.xlsx and SLA_options.pdf. Please let us know any hard dates on your side and whether data residency (US-only) is required — we can pin a US-only deployment if needed.

Next step: propose a 30-min alignment call tomorrow to lock owners and dates.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of GTM Ops — Redwood Inference

--

Question for procurement: is there any flexibility for the Order Form to be signed with an explicit "pending DPA" clause that allows PO issuance to begin earlier? If legal won't accept that, we should plan the 3-week procurement window after DPA signature.
